  fi
done)

trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' > "$work/all"
: > "$work/changed"

    *[Rr][Ee][Nn][Aa][Mm][Ee]*) continue ;;
  esac

    printf '%s\n' "$f" >> "$work/changed"

if [ -s "$work/changed" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r f; do git add -- "$f"; done < "$work/changed"
  git -c user.name=config-fix -c user.email=config-fix@localhost -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "Remove stale renamed config keys" > /dev/null
fi
